provenance.title: Smallest room sizes and the default size
provenance.covers: Smallest sensible side and area per room type, and the default size when none is entered. Common rules of thumb from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Technical housing standards: nationally described space standard (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
